name: foodsup-mobile
description: iOS and Android shells around the Food's Up web app. The website in the repo root stays the single source of truth.

scripts.android: npm run sync && . ./android-env.sh && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:run: npm run android && . ./android-env.sh && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell monkey -p app.yourfoodsup.planner -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
scripts.android:studio: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
